int[][][] dependencies(int[][] instructions)
    last := [for i := (0:<32)[] then -1]
    int[][][] result := []
    for: i < int(#instructions)
        int[][] operands := []
        for: 3 <= field <= 4 step 1
            source := instructions[i][field]
            if source > 0
                operands = operands.append([source, last[source]])
        result = result.append(operands)
        destination := instructions[i][2]
        if destination > 0
            last[destination] = i
    return result

bool id_resolved(int[] instruction, string stage)
    return (instruction[1] == 5 and instruction[3] < 0) or ((instruction[1] == 4 or instruction[1] == 5) and stage == "ID")

int ready(int[] instruction, int[] producer, int[] timing, bool forwarding, string stage)
    if not forwarding
        return timing[4] + 1
    result := if producer[1] == 2 then timing[4] else timing[3]
    return result + (if id_resolved(instruction, stage) then 1 else 0)

int path(int[] instruction, int[] producer_time, int[] instruction_time, bool forwarding, string stage)
    if #producer_time == 0 or not forwarding
        return 0
    resolved := id_resolved(instruction, stage)
    use_cycle := instruction_time[2] - (if resolved then 1 else 0)
    if producer_time[3] == use_cycle
        return 1
    if not resolved and producer_time[4] == use_cycle
        return 2
    return 0

import trace_io = "./trace_io.qui"
import hazards = "./hazards.qui"
import pipeline = "./pipeline.qui"
import predictors = "./predictors.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string[] instruction_classes()
    return ["ALU", "MUL", "LOAD", "STORE", "BRANCH", "JUMP", "NOP"]
string[] stall_causes()
    return ["control", "structural", "load_use", "raw"]
string[] pipeline_stages()
    return ["IF", "ID", "EX", "MEM", "WB"]

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

int sum(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

bool row_less(int[] first, int[] second)
    for: i < minimum(int(#first), int(#second))
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return #first < #second

int[][] sort_rows(int[][] values)
    width := 1
    n := int(#values)
    while width < n
        int[][] merged := []
        for: 0 <= first < n step 2 * width
            middle := minimum(first + width, n)
            last := minimum(first + 2 * width, n)
            left := first
            right := middle
            while left < middle or right < last
                if left < middle and (right >= last or not row_less(values[right], values[left]))
                    merged = merged.append(values[left])
                    left += 1
                else
                    merged = merged.append(values[right])
                    right += 1
        values = merged
        width *= 2
    return values

string words(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

bool control(int[] instruction)
    return instruction[1] == 4 or instruction[1] == 5

int index_of(string[] values, string key)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == key
            return i
    return -1

int get(map<int, int> values, int key)
    match values.get(key)
        int result
            return result
        none
            return 0

int[] get_group(map<int, int[]> values, int key)
    match values.get(key)
        int[] result
            return result
        none
            return []

string cause_values(int[] values)
    causes := stall_causes()
    return [for i := (0:<4)[] then "{causes[i]} {values[i]}"].join(" ")

class Checked(int[] instruction, string reason)

Checked check(string line, map<int, int> first, int[][] instructions)
    classes := instruction_classes()
    fields := line.split(" ")
    if #fields != 8
        return Checked([], "fields")
    for field := fields[]
        if field == ""
            return Checked([], "fields")
    pc := trace_io.hexadecimal(fields[0])
    if pc < 0 or pc % 4 != 0
        return Checked([], "pc")
    kind := index_of(classes, fields[1])
    if kind < 0
        return Checked([], "class")
    registers := [for i := (0:<3)[] then trace_io.register(fields[i + 2])]
    for: i < 3
        if fields[i + 2] != "-" and registers[i] < 0
            return Checked([], "register")
    int[][] usages := [[1, 1, 2], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 0], [0, 1, 1], [0, 1, 2], [2, 2, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
    for: i < 3
        if (usages[kind][i] == 1 and registers[i] < 0) or (usages[kind][i] == 0 and registers[i] >= 0)
            return Checked([], "operands")
    outcome := fields[5]
    if (kind == 4 and outcome != "T" and outcome != "N") or (kind == 5 and outcome != "T") or (kind != 4 and kind != 5 and outcome != "-")
        return Checked([], "taken")
    target := trace_io.hexadecimal(fields[6])
    if kind == 4 or kind == 5
        if target < 0 or target % 4 != 0 or target == pc + 4
            return Checked([], "target")
    elif fields[6] != "-"
        return Checked([], "target")
    address := trace_io.hexadecimal(fields[7])
    if kind == 2 or kind == 3
        if address < 0 or address % 4 != 0
            return Checked([], "address")
    elif fields[7] != "-"
        return Checked([], "address")
    result := [pc, kind, registers[0], registers[1], registers[2], (if outcome == "T" then 1 elif outcome == "N" then 0 else -1), target, address, (if outcome == "T" then target else pc + 4)]
    if first.has(pc)
        previous := instructions[get(first, pc)]
        for: 1 <= i <= 4 step 1
            if previous[i] != result[i]
                return Checked([], "conflict")
        if (kind == 4 or (kind == 5 and registers[1] < 0)) and previous[6] != target
            return Checked([], "conflict")
    return Checked(result, "")

class Trace(int lines, int[][] instructions, string[] rejected, string[] gaps, map<int, int> first)

Trace validate(string[] lines)
    int[][] instructions := []
    string[] rejected := []
    string[] gaps := []
    map<int, int> first
    for: i < int(#lines)
        result := check(lines[i], first, instructions)
        if result.reason != ""
            rejected = rejected.append("reject line {i + 1} {result.reason}")
        else
            instruction := result.instruction
            if #instructions > 0
                previous := instructions[-1]
                if previous[8] != instruction[0]
                    gaps = gaps.append("gap line {i + 1} expected " + report.hexadecimal(previous[8]) + " found " + report.hexadecimal(instruction[0]))
            if not first.has(instruction[0])
                .first.set(instruction[0], int(#instructions))
            instructions = instructions.append(instruction)
    return Trace(int(#lines), instructions, rejected, gaps, first)

class Prediction(bool[] flags, int[][] details, int[] statistics, int bits)

Prediction predict(int[][] instructions, trace_io.Predictor definition, trace_io.Config config)
    btb := predictors.BTB(config.btb)
    ras := predictors.RAS(config.ras)
    direction := predictors.Direction(definition.scheme, definition.parameters)
    bool[] flags := []
    int[][] details := []
    statistics := [for i := (0:<15)[] then 0]
    for instruction := instructions[]
        missed := false
        predicted := instruction[0] + 4
        miss_kind := -1
        if control(instruction)
            pc := instruction[0]
            target := instruction[6]
            taken := instruction[5] == 1
            candidate := btb.lookup(pc)
            statistics[9] += 1
            if candidate >= 0
                statistics[10] += 1
            if instruction[1] == 5 and instruction[2] < 0 and instruction[3] == 31
                statistics[12] += 1
                address := .ras.pop()
                if address >= 0
                    candidate = address
                    statistics[13] += 1
                    if address == target
                        statistics[14] += 1
            if instruction[1] == 5 and instruction[2] == 31
                statistics[11] += 1
                .ras.push(pc + 4)
            predicted_taken := instruction[1] == 5 or direction.predict(pc, target)
            if definition.scheme == "PERFECT"
                predicted = instruction[8]
            elif predicted_taken and candidate >= 0
                predicted = candidate
            missed = predicted != instruction[8]
            if missed
                miss_kind = if instruction[1] == 4 and predicted_taken != taken then 0 elif candidate < 0 then 1 else 2
                statistics[6 + miss_kind] += 1
                statistics[1] += 1
                statistics[if instruction[1] == 4 then 3 else 5] += 1
            statistics[0] += 1
            statistics[if instruction[1] == 4 then 2 else 4] += 1
            if instruction[1] == 4
                .direction.update(pc, taken)
            if taken
                .btb.insert(pc, target)
        flags = flags.append(missed)
        details = details.append([predicted, miss_kind])
    return Prediction(flags, details, statistics, direction.storage())

int[][] totals(int[][] records)
    int[][] result := [[0, 0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0]]
    for record := records[]
        result[0][record[0]] += record[1]
        result[1][record[0]] += 1
    return result

class Combination(int variant, int predictor, pipeline.Result simulation, int[] stalls, int[] events)
class Runs(Combination[] combinations, int primary)

Runs all_combinations(int[][] instructions, int[][][] sources, Prediction[] predictions, trace_io.Config config)
    Combination[] combinations := []
    primary := -1
    for: v < int(#config.variants)
        trace_io.Variant variant := config.variants[v]
        for: p < int(#predictions)
            simulation := pipeline.simulate(instructions, sources, variant.forwarding, variant.stage, variant.latency, predictions[p].flags)
            counts := totals(simulation.records)
            combinations = combinations.append(Combination(v, p, simulation, counts[0], counts[1]))
    int[] order := []
    for: i < int(#combinations)
        current := combinations[i]
        position := int(#order)
        for: j < int(#order)
            previous := combinations[order[j]]
            before := current.simulation.cycles < previous.simulation.cycles
            if current.simulation.cycles == previous.simulation.cycles
                string[] names := [config.variants[current.variant].name, config.variants[previous.variant].name].sorted()
                if names[0] != names[1]
                    before = config.variants[current.variant].name == names[0]
                else
                    string[] predictors_order := [config.predictors[current.predictor].name, config.predictors[previous.predictor].name].sorted()
                    before = config.predictors[current.predictor].name == predictors_order[0]
            if before
                position = j
                break
        order = order[0:<position].concat([i]).concat(order[position:<int(#order)])
    combinations = [for i := order[] then combinations[i]]
    for: i < int(#combinations)
        combination := combinations[i]
        if config.variants[combination.variant].name == config.primary[0] and config.predictors[combination.predictor].name == config.primary[1]
            primary = i
    return Runs(combinations, primary)

class Row(int number, int pc, string kind, string annotation, int[][] characters, int[][] occupied)

Row[] build_rows(int[][] instructions, Combination primary, Prediction prediction, trace_io.Config config)
    classes := instruction_classes()
    causes := stall_causes()
    annotations := [for i := (0:<int(#instructions))[] then ""]
    for record := primary.simulation.records[]
        if record[3] >= 0
            annotations[record[3]] += " {causes[record[0]]} {record[1]}"
    Row[] rows := []
    for: i < int(#instructions)
        instruction := instructions[i]
        t := primary.simulation.timings[i]
        annotation := annotations[i]
        if prediction.flags[i]
            kinds := ["direction", "btb_miss", "wrong_target"]
            annotation += " mispredict {kinds[prediction.details[i][1]]}"
        rows = rows.append(Row(i + 1, instruction[0], classes[instruction[1]], annotation,
            [[t[0], t[0], 0], [t[0] + 1, t[1] - 1, 1], [t[1], t[1], 2], [t[1] + 1, t[2] - 1, 1], [t[2], t[3] - 1, 3], [t[3], t[3], 4], [t[4], t[4], 5]],
            [[0, t[0], t[1] - 1], [1, t[1], t[2] - 1], [2, t[2], t[3] - 1], [3, t[3], t[3]], [4, t[4], t[4]]]))
        if prediction.flags[i]
            resolved := hazards.id_resolved(instruction, config.variants[primary.variant].stage)
            cancel := t[2] + (if resolved then 0 else 1)
            int[][] characters := [[t[1], t[1], 0], [t[1] + 1, t[2] - 1, 1], [cancel, cancel, 6]]
            int[][] occupied := [[0, t[1], t[2] - 1]]
            if not resolved
                characters = characters.append([t[2], t[2], 2])
                occupied = occupied.append([1, t[2], t[2]])
            rows = rows.append(Row(-1, prediction.details[i][0], "FLUSH", "", characters, occupied))
            if not resolved
                rows = rows.append(Row(-1, prediction.details[i][0] + 4, "FLUSH", "", [[t[2], t[2], 0], [t[2] + 1, t[2] + 1, 6]], [[0, t[2], t[2]]]))
    return rows

string[] pipeline_lines(Row[] rows, Combination primary, trace_io.Config config)
    first := config.window[0]
    last := config.window[1]
    width := last - first + 1
    lines := ["pipeline variant={config.primary[0]} predictor={config.primary[1]} cycles {first}-{last}", report.heading(first, last)]
    contents := [for i := (0:<int(width))[] then [".", ".", ".", ".", "."]]
    visible := 0
    stalled := 0
    flushed := 0
    symbols := ["F", "*", "D", "X", "M", "W", "x"]
    for row := rows[]
        characters := [for i := (0:<int(width))[] then "."]
        for span := row.characters[]
            for: maximum(first, span[0]) <= cycle <= minimum(last, span[1]) step 1
                characters[cycle - first] = symbols[span[2]]
        nonempty := false
        for character := characters[]
            if character != "."
                nonempty = true
            if character == "*"
                stalled += 1
            if character == "x"
                flushed += 1
        if nonempty
            visible += 1
            lines = lines.append(report.row(row.number, row.pc, row.kind, characters.join(""), row.annotation))
        for span := row.occupied[]
            for: maximum(first, span[1]) <= cycle <= minimum(last, span[2]) step 1
                contents[cycle - first][span[0]] = if row.number < 0 then "w" else string(row.number)
    completed := 0
    for timing := primary.simulation.timings[]
        if timing[4] >= first and timing[4] <= last
            completed += 1
    lines = lines.concat(["rows {visible} completed {completed} stall_cells {stalled} flushed {flushed}", "", "stages", "cycle IF ID EX MEM WB"])
    for: first <= cycle <= last step 1
        lines = lines.append(string(cycle) + " " + contents[cycle - first].join(" "))
    return lines

string accuracy(Prediction prediction, int kind)
    statistics := prediction.statistics
    return report.percentage(statistics[kind] - statistics[kind + 1], statistics[kind])

map<int, int[]> group_instructions(int[][] instructions)
    map<int, int[]> groups
    for: i < int(#instructions)
        pc := instructions[i][0]
        .groups.set(pc, get_group(groups, pc).append(i))
    return groups

class Aggregate(int[] class_stalls, int[][] stalls, int[][] pairs)

Aggregate aggregate(int[][] instructions, int[][] records, int[] pcs)
    class_stalls := [for i := (0:<7)[] then 0]
    stalls := [for pc := pcs[] then [0, 0, 0, 0]]
    map<int, int> pc_indices
    for: i < int(#pcs)
        .pc_indices.set(pcs[i], i)
    int[][] pairs := []
    map<string, int> pair_indices
    for record := records[]
        instruction := instructions[record[2]]
        class_stalls[instruction[1]] += record[1]
        stalls[get(pc_indices, instruction[0])][record[0]] += record[1]
        if record[0] >= 2
            producer := instructions[record[4]][0]
            waiting := instructions[record[3]][0]
            key := "{producer}:{waiting}:{record[0]}"
            index := int(#pairs)
            match pair_indices.get(key)
                int found
                    index = found
                none
                    .pair_indices.set(key, index)
                    pairs = pairs.append([producer, waiting, record[0], 0, 0])
            pairs[index][3] += record[1]
            pairs[index][4] += 1
    int[][] sort_keys := [for i := (0:<int(#pairs))[] then [-pairs[i][3], pairs[i][0], pairs[i][1], pairs[i][2], i]]
    sort_keys = sort_rows(sort_keys)
    pairs = [for key := sort_keys[] then pairs[key[4]]]
    return Aggregate(class_stalls, stalls, pairs)

string[] statistics_lines(Trace trace, int[][][] sources, Prediction[] predictions, Runs runs, Row[] rows, trace_io.Config config)
    classes := instruction_classes()
    causes := stall_causes()
    stages := pipeline_stages()
    instructions := trace.instructions
    n := int(#instructions)
    primary := runs.combinations[runs.primary]
    trace_io.Variant variant := config.variants[primary.variant]
    cycles := primary.simulation.cycles
    pcs := trace.first.keys().sorted()
    string[] input_part := ["input lines {trace.lines} accepted {n} rejected {#trace.rejected} gaps {#trace.gaps}"].concat(trace.rejected).concat(trace.gaps)
    counts := [for i := (0:<7)[] then 0]
    distances := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    distinct<int> addresses
    taken := 0
    backward := 0
    indirect := 0
    links := 0
    source_count := 0
    for: i < n
        instruction := instructions[i]
        counts[instruction[1]] += 1
        if instruction[7] >= 0
            .addresses.add(instruction[7])
        if instruction[1] == 4
            if instruction[5] == 1
                taken += 1
            if instruction[6] < instruction[0]
                backward += 1
        elif instruction[1] == 5
            if instruction[3] >= 0
                indirect += 1
            if instruction[2] >= 0
                links += 1
        source_count += int(#sources[i])
        for source := sources[i][]
            if source[1] >= 0
                distances[minimum(5, i - source[1]) - 1] += 1
    static_counts := [0, 0]
    for pc := pcs[]
        kind := instructions[get(trace.first, pc)][1]
        if kind == 4 or kind == 5
            static_counts[kind - 4] += 1
    mix := [for i := (0:<7)[] then "{classes[i]} {counts[i]}"].join(" ")
    distance_labels := ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5+"]
    distance_values := [for i := (0:<5)[] then "{distance_labels[i]} {distances[i]}"].join(" ")
    trace_part := ["trace", "instructions {n}", "static_instructions {#pcs}", "mix {mix}",
        "branches {counts[4]} taken {taken} backward {backward}", "jumps {counts[5]} indirect {indirect} link {links}",
        "static_control branches {static_counts[0]} jumps {static_counts[1]}",
        "memory loads {counts[2]} stores {counts[3]} distinct_addresses {addresses.size()}",
        "operands {source_count} with_producer {sum(distances)} distance {distance_values}"]
    prediction_part := ["prediction"]
    for: p < int(#predictions)
        trace_io.Predictor definition := config.predictors[p]
        prediction := predictions[p]
        s := prediction.statistics
        prediction_part = prediction_part.append("{definition.name} {definition.scheme} bits {prediction.bits} control {s[0]} mispredicted {s[1]} accuracy " + accuracy(prediction, 0) + " branches " + accuracy(prediction, 2) + " jumps " + accuracy(prediction, 4) + " direction {s[6]} btb_miss {s[7]} wrong_target {s[8]}")
    btb_stats := predictions[0].statistics
    prediction_part = prediction_part.concat(["btb entries {config.btb} lookups {btb_stats[9]} hits {btb_stats[10]} misses {btb_stats[9] - btb_stats[10]}", "ras depth {config.ras} calls {btb_stats[11]} returns {btb_stats[12]} predicted {btb_stats[13]} correct {btb_stats[14]}"])
    lengths := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for delay := primary.simulation.delays[]
        if delay > 0
            lengths[minimum(5, delay) - 1] += 1
    int[] finish := []
    height := 0
    for: i < n
        start := 0
        for source := sources[i][]
            if source[1] >= 0
                start = maximum(start, finish[source[1]])
        cost := if instructions[i][1] == 2 then 2 elif instructions[i][1] == 1 then variant.latency else 1
        finish = finish.append(start + cost)
        height = maximum(height, finish[i])
    flushed := 0
    for row := rows[]
        if row.number < 0
            flushed += 1
    stalls := sum(primary.stalls)
    cpi_causes := [for i := (0:<4)[] then causes[i] + " " + report.decimal(primary.stalls[i], n)]
    timing_part := ["timing variant={variant.name} predictor={config.primary[1]}",
        "forwarding " + (if variant.forwarding then "on" else "off") + " branch_stage {variant.stage} mul_latency {variant.latency}",
        "cycles {cycles}", "cpi " + report.fraction(cycles, n) + " " + report.decimal(cycles, n), "ipc " + report.decimal(n, cycles),
        "stall_cycles total {stalls} " + cause_values(primary.stalls), "stall_events " + cause_values(primary.events), "flushed {flushed}",
        "cycle_check {n} + 4 + {stalls} = {n + 4 + stalls}", "cpi_stack base 1.0000 fill " + report.decimal(4, n) + " " + cpi_causes.join(" "),
        "stall_lengths " + [for i := (0:<5)[] then "{distance_labels[i]} {lengths[i]}"].join(" "), "dataflow height {height} ilp " + report.decimal(n, height)]
    whatif := ["whatif"]
    for: change < 4
        forwarding := variant.forwarding
        stage := variant.stage
        latency := variant.latency
        flags := predictions[primary.predictor].flags
        name := "perfect_prediction"
        if change == 0
            flags = [for i := (0:<int(n))[] then false]
        elif change == 1
            name = "single_cycle_mul"
            latency = 1
        elif change == 2
            forwarding = not forwarding
            name = if forwarding then "forwarding_on" else "forwarding_off"
        else
            stage = if stage == "ID" then "EX" else "ID"
            name = "branch_stage_" + stage
        simulation := pipeline.simulate(instructions, sources, forwarding, stage, latency, flags)
        whatif = whatif.append("{name} cycles {simulation.cycles} saved {cycles - simulation.cycles} speedup " + report.decimal(cycles, simulation.cycles))
    analysis := aggregate(instructions, primary.simulation.records, pcs)
    class_part := ["classes"]
    for: i < 7
        per_instruction := if counts[i] == 0 then "-" else report.decimal(analysis.class_stalls[i], counts[i])
        class_part = class_part.append("{classes[i]} count {counts[i]} stall_cycles {analysis.class_stalls[i]} per_instruction {per_instruction}")
    paths := [0, 0, 0]
    for: i < n
        for source := sources[i][]
            int[] producer_time := if source[1] < 0 then [] else primary.simulation.timings[source[1]]
            paths[hazards.path(instructions[i], producer_time, primary.simulation.timings[i], variant.forwarding, variant.stage)] += 1
    forwarding_part := ["forwarding regfile {paths[0]} ex_mem {paths[1]} mem_wb {paths[2]}"]
    occupancy := [for i := (0:<5)[] then [0, 0]]
    for row := rows[]
        for span := row.occupied[]
            occupancy[span[0]][if row.number < 0 then 1 else 0] += span[2] - span[1] + 1
    occupancy_part := ["occupancy cycles {cycles}"]
    for: i < 5
        a := occupancy[i][0]
        b := occupancy[i][1]
        occupancy_part = occupancy_part.append("{stages[i]} correct {a} wrong {b} idle {cycles - a - b} busy " + report.percentage(a + b, cycles))
    int[][] hotspot_keys := []
    for: i < int(#pcs)
        total := sum(analysis.stalls[i])
        if total > 0
            hotspot_keys = hotspot_keys.append([-total, pcs[i], i])
    hotspot_keys = sort_rows(hotspot_keys)
    hotspots := ["hotspots"]
    for: rank < minimum(config.top, int(#hotspot_keys))
        key := hotspot_keys[rank]
        kind := instructions[get(trace.first, key[1])][1]
        hotspots = hotspots.append("{rank + 1} " + report.hexadecimal(key[1]) + " {classes[kind]} stall_cycles {-key[0]} " + cause_values(analysis.stalls[key[2]]))
    dependency_part := ["dependencies total {#analysis.pairs}"]
    for: rank < minimum(config.top, int(#analysis.pairs))
        pair := analysis.pairs[rank]
        producer_kind := instructions[get(trace.first, pair[0])][1]
        waiting_kind := instructions[get(trace.first, pair[1])][1]
        dependency_part = dependency_part.append("{rank + 1} " + report.hexadecimal(pair[0]) + " {classes[producer_kind]} -> " + report.hexadecimal(pair[1]) + " {classes[waiting_kind]} {causes[pair[2]]} stall_cycles {pair[3]} events {pair[4]}")
    intervals := ["intervals size {config.interval}"]
    for: 0 <= first < n step config.interval
        last := minimum(n, first + config.interval) - 1
        count := primary.simulation.timings[last][4] - (if first == 0 then 0 else primary.simulation.timings[first - 1][4])
        intervals = intervals.append("{first + 1}-{last + 1} cycles {count} cpi " + report.decimal(count, last - first + 1))
    string[] names := [for definition := config.predictors[] then definition.name]
    cycle_table := ["cycles_table " + names.join(" ")]
    for: v < int(#config.variants)
        int[] values := []
        for: p < int(#predictions)
            for combination := runs.combinations[]
                if combination.variant == v and combination.predictor == p
                    values = values.append(combination.simulation.cycles)
        cycle_table = cycle_table.append(config.variants[v].name + " " + words(values))
    return report.join([input_part, trace_part, prediction_part, timing_part, whatif, class_part, forwarding_part, occupancy_part, hotspots, dependency_part, intervals, cycle_table])

string[] branch_lines(int[][] instructions, map<int, int[]> groups, Prediction[] predictions, trace_io.Config config)
    classes := instruction_classes()
    lines := ["predictor,pc,class,executions,taken,mispredictions,accuracy"]
    for: p < int(#predictions)
        for pc := groups.keys().sorted()[]
            indices := get_group(groups, pc)
            instruction := instructions[indices[0]]
            if control(instruction)
                taken := 0
                missed := 0
                for i := indices[]
                    taken += if instructions[i][5] == 1 then 1 else 0
                    missed += if predictions[p].flags[i] then 1 else 0
                lines = lines.append(config.predictors[p].name + "," + report.hexadecimal(pc) + ",{classes[instruction[1]]},{#indices},{taken},{missed}," + report.percentage(int(#indices) - missed, int(#indices)))
    return lines

string[] comparison_lines(Runs runs, Prediction[] predictions, trace_io.Config config, int count)
    lines := ["rank,variant,predictor,cycles,cpi,speedup,accuracy,mispredictions,control,structural,load_use,raw"]
    cycles := runs.combinations[runs.primary].simulation.cycles
    for: rank < int(#runs.combinations)
        combination := runs.combinations[rank]
        string[] values := [string(rank + 1), config.variants[combination.variant].name, config.predictors[combination.predictor].name, string(combination.simulation.cycles), report.decimal(combination.simulation.cycles, count), report.decimal(cycles, combination.simulation.cycles), accuracy(predictions[combination.predictor], 0), string(predictions[combination.predictor].statistics[1])]
        values = values.concat([for value := combination.stalls[] then string(value)])
        lines = lines.append(values.join(","))
    return lines

string[] profile_lines(Trace trace, map<int, int[]> groups, Prediction[] predictions, Combination primary, trace_io.Config config)
    classes := instruction_classes()
    instructions := trace.instructions
    branches := ["branches"]
    loops := ["loops"]
    indirect := ["indirect"]
    static := ["instructions"]
    map<int, int> stalled
    for record := primary.simulation.records[]
        pc := instructions[record[2]][0]
        .stalled.set(pc, get(stalled, pc) + record[1])
    for pc := groups.keys().sorted()[]
        indices := get_group(groups, pc)
        count := int(#indices)
        instruction := instructions[indices[0]]
        if instruction[1] == 4
            taken := 0
            transitions := 0
            previous := -1
            length := 0
            longest := [0, 0]
            int[] trips := []
            trip_length := 0
            max_trip := 0
            for i := indices[]
                outcome := instructions[i][5]
                taken += outcome
                if previous >= 0 and previous != outcome
                    transitions += 1
                length = if previous == outcome then length + 1 else 1
                longest[outcome] = maximum(longest[outcome], length)
                previous = outcome
                trip_length += 1
                if outcome == 0
                    trips = trips.append(trip_length)
                    max_trip = maximum(max_trip, trip_length)
                    trip_length = 0
            if trip_length > 0
                trips = trips.append(trip_length)
                max_trip = maximum(max_trip, trip_length)
            best := -1
            best_misses := 0
            for: p < int(#predictions)
                if config.predictors[p].scheme != "PERFECT"
                    missed := 0
                    for i := indices[]
                        missed += if predictions[p].flags[i] then 1 else 0
                    if best < 0 or missed < best_misses
                        best = p
                        best_misses = missed
            direction := if instruction[6] < pc then "backward" else "forward"
            branches = branches.append(report.hexadecimal(pc) + " {direction} executions {count} taken {taken} transitions {transitions} longest_taken {longest[1]} longest_not_taken {longest[0]} best {config.predictors[best].name} {best_misses}")
            if instruction[6] < pc
                loops = loops.append(report.hexadecimal(instruction[6]) + "-" + report.hexadecimal(pc) + " body {(pc - instruction[6]) / 4 + 1} entries {#trips} iterations {count} avg_trip " + report.decimal(count, int(#trips)) + " max_trip {max_trip}")
        elif instruction[1] == 5 and instruction[3] >= 0
            map<int, int> targets
            for i := indices[]
                target := instructions[i][6]
                .targets.set(target, get(targets, target) + 1)
            int[][] order := [for target := targets.keys()[] then [-get(targets, target), target]]
            order = sort_rows(order)
            values := [for key := order[] then report.hexadecimal(key[1]) + ":" + string(-key[0])]
            indirect = indirect.append(report.hexadecimal(pc) + " executions {count} distinct {targets.size()} targets " + values.join(" "))
        registers := [for field := (2:<5)[] then report.register(instruction[field])].join(" ")
        static = static.append(report.hexadecimal(pc) + " {classes[instruction[1]]} {registers} executions {count} stall_cycles {get(stalled, pc)}")
    map<int, int[]> segment_groups
    first := 0
    for: last < int(#instructions)
        if control(instructions[last]) or last == int(#instructions) - 1
            pc := instructions[first][0]
            group := get_group(segment_groups, pc)
            if #group == 0
                group = [0, 0, 0]
            group[0] += 1
            group[1] += last - first + 1
            group[2] += primary.simulation.timings[last][4] - (if first == 0 then 0 else primary.simulation.timings[first - 1][4])
            .segment_groups.set(pc, group)
            first = last + 1
    int[][] ranked := []
    for pc := segment_groups.keys()[]
        group := get_group(segment_groups, pc)
        ranked = ranked.append([-group[2], pc])
    ranked = sort_rows(ranked)
    segments := ["segments total {segment_groups.size()}"]
    for: rank < minimum(config.top, int(#ranked))
        pc := ranked[rank][1]
        group := get_group(segment_groups, pc)
        segments = segments.append("{rank + 1} " + report.hexadecimal(pc) + " instances {group[0]} instructions {group[1]} cycles {group[2]} cpi " + report.decimal(group[2], group[1]))
    return report.join([branches, loops, segments, indirect, static])

void run()
    config := trace_io.read_config()
    trace := validate(trace_io.lines("input/trace.txt"))
    sources := hazards.dependencies(trace.instructions)
    predictions := [for definition := config.predictors[] then predict(trace.instructions, definition, config)]
    runs := all_combinations(trace.instructions, sources, predictions, config)
    primary := runs.combinations[runs.primary]
    rows := build_rows(trace.instructions, primary, predictions[primary.predictor], config)
    groups := group_instructions(trace.instructions)
    report.write("pipeline.txt", pipeline_lines(rows, primary, config))
    report.write("stats.txt", statistics_lines(trace, sources, predictions, runs, rows, config))
    report.write("branches.csv", branch_lines(trace.instructions, groups, predictions, config))
    report.write("comparison.csv", comparison_lines(runs, predictions, config, int(#trace.instructions)))
    report.write("profile.txt", profile_lines(trace, groups, predictions, primary, config))

run()

import hazards = "./hazards.qui"

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

class Result(int[][] timings, int[][] records, int[] delays, int cycles)

Result simulate(int[][] instructions, int[][][] sources, bool forwarding, string stage, int latency, bool[] missed)
    int[][] timings := []
    int[][] records := []
    int[] delays := []
    for: i < int(#instructions)
        instruction := instructions[i]
        length := if instruction[1] == 1 then latency else 1
        fetch := 1
        decode := 2
        start := 3
        if i > 0
            previous := timings[i - 1]
            fetch = previous[1]
            if missed[i - 1]
                fetch = previous[2] + (if hazards.id_resolved(instructions[i - 1], stage) then 0 else 1)
            decode = maximum(fetch + 1, previous[2])
            ideal := previous[2] + 1
            available := [ideal, ideal]
            producers := [-1, -1]
            for source := sources[i][]
                p := source[1]
                if p >= 0
                    cycle := hazards.ready(instruction, instructions[p], timings[p], forwarding, stage)
                    slot := if instructions[p][1] == 2 then 0 else 1
                    if cycle > available[slot]
                        available[slot] = cycle
                        producers[slot] = p
            bounds := [decode + 1, previous[3], available[0], available[1]]
            start = ideal
            for: cause < 4
                if bounds[cause] > start
                    records = records.append([cause, bounds[cause] - start, (if cause < 2 then i - 1 else i), i, (if cause < 2 then -1 else producers[cause - 2])])
                    start = bounds[cause]
            delays = delays.append(start - ideal)
        timings = timings.append([fetch, decode, start, start + length, start + length + 1])
    last := int(#instructions) - 1
    if instructions[last][1] == 1 and latency >= 2
        records = records.append([1, latency - 1, last, -1, -1])
    return Result(timings, records, delays, timings[last][4])

int bounded(int value, bool taken)
    if taken
        return if value < 3 then value + 1 else 3
    return if value > 0 then value - 1 else 0

int xor(int first, int second)
    result := 0
    bit := 1
    while first > 0 or second > 0
        if first % 2 != second % 2
            result += bit
        first /= 2
        second /= 2
        bit *= 2
    return result

class BTB(int size)
    int[][] entries := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [-1, -1]]

    int lookup(int pc)
        entry := entries[(pc / 4) % size]
        return if entry[0] == pc then entry[1] else -1

    void .insert(int pc, int target)
        entries[(pc / 4) % size] = [pc, target]

class RAS(int depth)
    int[] stack := []

    void .push(int address)
        if depth > 0
            if int(#stack) == depth
                stack = stack[1:<int(#stack)]
            stack = stack.append(address)

    int .pop()
        if #stack == 0
            return -1
        result := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        return result

class Direction(string scheme, int[] parameters)
    history := 0
    int[] table := [for i := (0:<(if #parameters > 0 then parameters[0] else 0))[] then (if scheme == "ONEBIT" then 0 else 1)]
    int[] local_table := [for i := (0:<(if scheme == "TOURNAMENT" then parameters[0] else 0))[] then 1]
    int[] global_table := [for i := (0:<(if scheme == "TOURNAMENT" then parameters[1] else 0))[] then 1]
    int[] chooser := [for i := (0:<(if scheme == "TOURNAMENT" then parameters[3] else 0))[] then 1]

    bool predict(int pc, int target)
        index := pc / 4
        if scheme == "STATIC_NT" or scheme == "PERFECT"
            return false
        if scheme == "BTFN"
            return target < pc
        if scheme == "ONEBIT"
            return table[index % int(#table)] == 1
        if scheme == "TWOBIT"
            return table[index % int(#table)] >= 2
        if scheme == "GSHARE"
            return table[xor(index, history) % int(#table)] >= 2
        if chooser[index % int(#chooser)] >= 2
            return global_table[xor(index, history) % int(#global_table)] >= 2
        return local_table[index % int(#local_table)] >= 2

    void .update(int pc, bool taken)
        if scheme == "STATIC_NT" or scheme == "BTFN" or scheme == "PERFECT"
            return
        index := pc / 4
        if scheme == "TOURNAMENT"
            li := index % int(#local_table)
            gi := xor(index, history) % int(#global_table)
            ci := index % int(#chooser)
            lp := local_table[li] >= 2
            gp := global_table[gi] >= 2
            if lp != gp
                chooser[ci] = bounded(chooser[ci], gp == taken)
            local_table[li] = bounded(local_table[li], taken)
            global_table[gi] = bounded(global_table[gi], taken)
            history = (2 * history + (if taken then 1 else 0)) % (2 ^ parameters[2])
        else
            if scheme == "GSHARE"
                index = xor(index, history)
            index %= int(#table)
            table[index] = if scheme == "ONEBIT" then (if taken then 1 else 0) else bounded(table[index], taken)
            if scheme == "GSHARE"
                history = (2 * history + (if taken then 1 else 0)) % (2 ^ parameters[1])

    int storage()
        if scheme == "ONEBIT"
            return parameters[0]
        if scheme == "TWOBIT"
            return 2 * parameters[0]
        if scheme == "GSHARE"
            return 2 * parameters[0] + parameters[1]
        if scheme == "TOURNAMENT"
            return 2 * (parameters[0] + parameters[1] + parameters[3]) + parameters[2]
        return 0

string padded(int value, int width, string fill)
    text := string(value)
    return string.repeat(fill, nat(width - int(#text))) + text

string decimal(int p, int q)
    scaled := (2 * p * 10000 + q) / (2 * q)
    return string(scaled / 10000) + "." + padded(scaled % 10000, 4, "0")

string percentage(int p, int q)
    if q == 0
        return "-"
    scaled := (2 * p * 10000 + q) / (2 * q)
    return string(scaled / 100) + "." + padded(scaled % 100, 2, "0")

string fraction(int p, int q)
    a := p
    b := q
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return string(p / a) + "/" + string(q / a)

string hexadecimal(int value)
    low := nat(value % 4294967296)
    hex := low.b16
    return "0" * (8 - #hex) + hex

string register(int value)
    return if value < 0 then "-" else "r" + string(value)

string heading(int first, int last)
    return "cycle" + " " * 18 + [for cycle := (int(first):<(int(last) + 1))[] then string(cycle % 10)].join("")

string row(int number, int pc, string kind, string characters, string annotation)
    identifier := if number < 0 then "     -" else padded(number, 6, " ")
    return identifier + " " + hexadecimal(pc) + " " + kind + " " * nat(6 - int(#kind)) + " " + characters + annotation

string[] join(string[][] parts)
    string[] result := []
    for: i < int(#parts)
        if i > 0
            result = result.append("")
        result = result.concat(parts[i])
    return result

void write(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

string[] lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

int hexadecimal(string text)
    if #text != 8
        return -1
    result := 0
    digits := "0123456789abcdef"
    for: position < int(#text)
        character := text[position]
        digit := -1
        for: i < 16
            if digits[i] == character
                digit = i
        if digit < 0
            return -1
        result = 16 * result + digit
    return result

int register(string text)
    if #text < 2 or text[0] != "r" or #text > 3
        return -1
    digits := text[1:<int(#text)]
    if #digits > 1 and digits[0] == "0"
        return -1
    result := 0
    for: position < int(#digits)
        character := digits[position]
        digit := -1
        for: i < 10
            if string(i) == character
                digit = i
        if digit < 0
            return -1
        result = 10 * result + digit
    return if result <= 31 then result else -1

class Predictor(string name, string scheme, int[] parameters)
class Variant(string name, bool forwarding, string stage, int latency)
class Config(int btb, int ras, Predictor[] predictors, Variant[] variants, string[] primary, int[] window, int top, int interval)

Config read_config()
    btb := 0
    ras := 0
    top := 0
    interval := 0
    Predictor[] predictors := []
    Variant[] variants := []
    string[] primary := []
    int[] window := []
    for row := lines("input/config.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        key := fields[0]
        if key == "BTB"
            btb = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "RAS"
            ras = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "TOP"
            top = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "INTERVAL"
            interval = integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "PRIMARY"
            primary = fields[1:<3]
        elif key == "WINDOW"
            window = [integer(fields[1]), integer(fields[2])]
        elif key == "PREDICTOR"
            parameters := [for text := fields[3:<int(#fields)][] then integer(text)]
            predictors = predictors.append(Predictor(fields[1], fields[2], parameters))
        else
            variants = variants.append(Variant(fields[1], fields[2] == "ON", fields[3], integer(fields[4])))
    return Config(btb, ras, predictors, variants, primary, window, top, interval)
